title: A bot rejects your resume in about ten seconds before a single human ever reads it
description:
A bot rejects your resume in ~10 seconds before a human ever sees it. Here are the 3 Claude prompts that beat it:

1. The Audit - paste your resume + the job description, Claude scores you out of 100 and flags every missing keyword.

2. The Rewrite - every bullet rewritten with Google's XYZ formula (accomplished X, measured by Y, by doing Z), keywords slipped in naturally.

3. The Simulation - Claude becomes the ATS bot AND the hiring manager reading 300 resumes, and tells you if yours makes the yes pile.

The people getting hired aren't more qualified. They just stopped writing for a human that never sees it.

Comment RESUME and I'll send you all three prompts.

#ai #claude #resume #jobsearch #careertips #ats #productivity #aitools #jobinterview #careerhacks
